data.content:
Timão's Under-20 coach will be without Rodrigo Garro and Kaio César for this round. Both received their third yellow card in the last match and will serve an automatic suspension.

A standout performer for Corinthians in big matches against Palmeiras, goalkeeper Hugo Souza expressed confidence in his teammates as the Black and Whites look to secure their ninth win in the Brazilian Championship and climb the standings. Timão have 32 points and sit in 16th place. [...] "Every game has its own story, but a Derby is always different from any other match. I'm sure we're fully focused on doing our best. We know we have what it takes to go there (Nubank Parque) and get a great result. We have tremendous faith in our team and the quality we have to play a great game and, God willing, get an away win against our biggest rival. I really want it to be a great game.
